title: strike shopping centre sumy northern ukraine kills three governor says 2026 09 09
text:
Sept 9 (Reuters) - A Russian drone strike on a ​shopping centre in the northern Ukrainian ‌city of Sumy killed two people and injured 20, four of them seriously, ​Regional Governor Oleh Hryhorov said.
Hryhorov, ​writing on Telegram, initially said three ⁠people had died but later ​corrected the death toll to two.
He said ​a fire had broken out, and photos posted online by the governor showed a ​badly damaged building and rubble ​strewn on the ground.
Four people were in serious ‌condition, ⁠Hryhorov said. Four of the injured were teenagers, the national police said separately on Telegram.
Across the wider region, ​five ​people were ⁠killed and 24 injured, the police added.
Sumy and the ​surrounding region along the Russian ​border ⁠have long been subject to heavy attacks and Moscow has said it ⁠wants ​to establish a buffer ​zone in the area.
